sourceProjection.basis: PDF page 11, figure 3, is explicitly captioned as the Castello di Milano plan at the Piazza d'Armi level. Parallel walls, scale bar and top-down room/courtyard outlines establish orthographic projection. Coordinates use the native 720 by 480 page, with its 90-degree display rotation removed. Rechecked every courtyard label and the actual Filarete doorway against the native-coordinate source grid; the entrance faces right on this unrotated plan.

review: Politecnico di Milano repository paper in Defensive Architecture of the Mediterranean XVI (2024), PDF page 11, figure 3. The embedded 745 x 681 Piazza d'Armi-level plan was inspected at native resolution. Dark neutral architectural ink is retained; the author's red Rocchetta study circle and pale demolished Ghirlanda context are not promoted. The official 2025 city map is retained as provenance and was audited separately: its page 1 is an orthographic site-level museum locator, while page 2 contains axonometric collection-distribution blocks and is not emitted as upper-floor geometry.

sourceProjection.basis: The original official file is retained as provenance. Page 1 is a top-down site-level museum locator. Page 2 is axonometric and is excluded from generated floor geometry.

limitations: 当前模型只保留武器广场标高的建筑研究平面，可证明城堡核心、武器广场、罗凯塔、公爵庭院和南侧主入口轴线；它不是现行博物馆逐层导览图。
厚实黑色结构墨迹抬升为墙体，细部、楼梯线、比例尺和文字保持平面；红色研究圆与浅灰色已拆防御工事不进入墙体。
米兰市政府2025年官方附件第1页是正投影场地定位图，可证明各博物馆所属馆翼；第2页四张图是带竖向厚度的轴测馆藏分布图，不是可直接挤出的房间平面。
先前四塔仿射拟合只把轴测图的两个地面轴校正到正投影，不能消除彩色顶面的高度投影；因此地下层、一层、二层的重复外轮廓和漂移锚点已全部撤下。
导览停靠点0至2只绑定入口和两个具名庭院。停靠点3至5涉及博物馆馆藏或上层空间，在取得可靠分层平面或完成逐馆翼去投影前保持未绑定，不以重复城堡外轮廓凑层数。
